messages:
emma_cs: FYI OnboardCorp asked for a concise SLO report and explanation of a latency blip last week. they want the uptime % for the quarter, the incident window, and how we calculated any credits. can ops / eng confirm what evidence we should attach?

raj_ops: ack. which customer environment (prod vs dedicated)?

emma_cs: prod (hosted, us-west). renewal discussion next Tues so they want it by Mon EOD.

raj_ops: got it. we'll need: uptime graph (7d/30d/quarter), p50/p95 latency distribution, the exact incident window (start/end ts), and root-cause blurb. also link to dashboards.

maria_se: I can draft the customer-facing one-pager (one slide) with the numbers and a short technical note. can someone paste the PromQL we use for latency SLO?

raj_ops: PromQL we usually share: ``histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job))`` but for customer doc we produce p50/p95 from the dashboard export. for uptime: ``sum(up == 1) / count(up) * 100`` over the quarter window.

dan_oncall: slo-bot flagged an SLO breach on 2467340000 — it coincides with cache warmup and a GVF deploy. ops notes: KV cache priming increased tail latencies for ~18m. attaching a quick snippet of the deploy log:
```
2026-03-14T18:03:12Z deploy: model-quantize-v2 rolling
2026-03-14T18:07:55Z cache: clear prefix /user-prefix
2026-03-14T18:21:04Z anomalies: p95 latency jump 420ms -> 1.2s
```

emma_cs: perfect. Alex, can you own the customer comms? Also we need the credit calc and legal wording.

alex_csm: i can do the comms. for credits - our standard is prorated minutes of downtime beyond SLO threshold * monthly fee factor. i'll pull the template from the SLA repo.

maria_se: draft plan: i'll make one slide: 1) headline uptime % and credit owed 2) timeline + graphs 3) technical summary (KV cache warmup, deploy) 4) next steps to avoid recurrence. need the exported CSV of p50/p95 and the exact incident start/end from ops.

raj_ops: extracting logs + dashboard exports now. quick check: do we want to include raw traces or aggregated traces only? customers often prefer aggregated graphs with an appendix for raw traces if they ask.

emma_cs: aggregated in main doc, raw traces as appendix. include a short note about mitigation (staggered cache warms, deploy ramp policy).

slo-bot: [ALERT] SLO breach recorded for OnboardCorp (prod, us-west). window 2026-03-14T18:04:00Z - 2026-03-14T18:22:00Z. p95 exceeded 1s. ticket #CS-7891 created. :rotating_light:

dan_oncall: ticket + incident timeline added to CS-7891. ops will attach the Prometheus export and the Grafana PNGs.

alex_csm: I'll draft the comms and share the customer-ready PDF by Sun noon. cc @emma_cs @maria_se for review.

emma_cs: thanks team. can we also add a short FAQ about credits (how calculated, timeline for issuing) in the appendix? legal wants that included.

maria_se: yup will add FAQ + sample credit calc table. will use this example row: "Incident duration (min): 18 -> Credit = (18/43200)*monthly_fee" and explain assumptions.

raj_ops: exported artifacts pushed to the shared drive: /shared/CS/OnboardCorp/SLO_evidence_2467890123/

emma_cs: awesome. i'll review comms Mon morning and send to the customer Mon EOD. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
